skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall key concepts, principles, and theories of labor economics.
Understand and distinguish basic differences and relationships between economic concepts, principles, and theories.
Understand the roles, motivations, and behaviors of market participants on the labor market.
Understand the factors influencing the labor market including macroeconomic, business, and individual factors.
Understand qualitative and quantitative analytical techniques used to assess relationships on the labor market.
Apply principles, theories, and research tools to understand phenomena on the labor market.
Analyze real-life situations on the labor market by applying learned principles and theories.
Evaluate and predict decisions of key actors on the labor market using learned theories and tools.
Be proactive in learning, researching, and working in groups.
Proactively choose topics, research methods, and present research results.
